title: Dead letter event, version 1
description: Shared envelope for every .dlq topic. It records why a payload could not be published to, or consumed from, its source topic, and carries the payload unchanged. See docs/data/topics.md.

schema_version.description: Major version of this contract. Always 1 for events written against this file.

source_topic.description: The topic the payload was meant for, or was read from. The dead letter topic is this name plus .dlq.

service.description: The service that dead lettered the payload, for example ingest or risk-engine. Needed because both the producer and every consumer validate.

stage.description: Where the failure happened. fetch: the provider request failed. decode: the bytes are not the expected JSON. validate: the event does not match its topic schema. publish: the broker rejected the write.

reason.description: Human readable error, including validation error paths where there are any.

failed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the failure. Always ends in Z.

source_url.description: The provider URL the payload came from, when there is one.

payload.description: The failing bytes, unchanged. Stored as text when they are valid UTF-8 and as base64 otherwise, because the bytes may not be valid JSON or valid UTF-8.

payload_encoding.description: How payload is encoded: utf-8 for the bytes as text, base64 otherwise.

payload_bytes.description: Length in bytes of the original payload before any encoding or truncation.

payload_truncated.description: True when payload holds only a prefix of the original bytes, because the original was too large to fit in a Kafka record. payload_bytes still gives the original length. Absent means false.
